scenario: The team plans a summer barbecue, so the episode is full of first-conditional planning and relative clauses. Kate: 'If the weather is good, we'll have it in the park. If it rains, we'll move to the office.' Pol: 'The person who brings the best salad wins a prize.' Den worries: 'If Alex cooks, everyone will be ill.' Alex: 'If Den brings his guitar, we'll all sing.' Peter offers to make a playlist. Valery says, 'If it's after six, I won't come.' A little zero-conditional fact slips in ('If you heat cheese, it melts'). Relative clauses describe things: 'the park which is near the office', 'the salad that Pol makes'. Warm, funny planning. Short A2 sentences; keep 'if + present, will + verb' clear.
